title: DepEd pushes ‘job-ready’ efforts for SHS students

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) partnered with more than 170 institutions in various fields as part of its effort to make senior high school (SHS) students job-ready after graduation. “Our graduates must enter the workforce with genuine hands-on experience and real competencies. By sitting down directly with our industry leaders, we are ensuring that what we teach in school matches what the real world actually demands,” Education Secretary Sonny Angara said in a statement.
